title: Factor the restored P104 collector through one Newton query
body:
## Why this result matters

[PR #3467](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3467) parametrized the larger stagewise P104 entrance, but its index did not establish what a restored caller can observe or whether the enlargement helps this collector. This package closes that logical interface and identifies exactly which coefficient directions reach Q.

Canonical investigation: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2750#discussioncomment-19010968

## Established result

For the declared [PR #3467](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3467) coefficient encoder K, append the actual 257-event producer cone, the actual 15-event first collector, a 252-event selective producer inverse, and K inverse. The core has 524 events; after the codec inverse, all 52 coefficient banks, all five dirty D banks, and all 58 public frames return, with private C erased at zero. Both codec directions are additional to the core inventory. The resulting update is

$$
Q_{\mathrm{out}}=Q_{\mathrm{in}}+E_9(a_2+a_9+a_{16}+a_{27}+a_{51}).
$$

The return omits exactly the five inverse Q compensation ADDs. Full reversal would incorrectly add the initial dirty-D sum; the literal check verifies that adverse control on all 512 coordinates.

This answers three connected questions:

1. **The larger entrance adds no five-readout range.** With L the inherited stagewise entrance and S=(4B9)^52, both map onto B9^5 under the same five group-sum readout. A common explicit terminal-source section gives L/S isomorphic to ker(rho5|L)/(S intersect ker(rho5|L)), of size 2^86072. Every relative class has a kernel representative. rho5 itself does **not** descend to L/S, since rho5(S)=B9^5.
2. **The source-derived caller can close with dirty restoration.** The specified selective inverse supplies the exact returned-state contract and the Q update above. This is a newly appended logical return, not an assertion about an existing full-word return.
3. **That caller factors through one Newton query.** Two strict register schedules gather the five terminal coefficients, apply E9, add to Q, apply E9 inverse, and ungather. All 52 original coefficients remain returned outputs; invisible directions are not erased or released storage.

The five-readout map has Gaussian-array rank 2,560 and the final increment rank 512, with respective coefficient kernels of ranks 24,064 and 26,112. These are observation dimensions, distinct from the source program's native recipe rank mass.

| Rank-nine strict real arithmetic | Owned zero Gaussian bank | Temporarily mutable terminal bank |
|---|---:|---:|
| ADD/SUB excluding doubling | 43,520 | 41,472 |
| Explicit doublings | 2,304 | 2,304 |
| Checked exact halves | 4,608 | 4,608 |
| Extra Gaussian banks | 1 | 0 |
| Separate real zero scratch words | 1 | 1 |

If doubling is charged as one ADD, the ADD totals are 45,824 and 43,776. Both schedules restore their work storage. Conservative component bounds are 67,260H for non-query arithmetic and J+16,815H for Q. COSTS.md separates these strict schedules from the source core's incomplete native/component inventory; it does not infer a physical speedup from unlike tariffs.

## Evidence and review scope

Public result commit: **9f225dda71c45e2e6fea70e2ff5ef9f27192e1f9**. Retained-source ancestor: **9e501ba770d31c9f3decd51c987081c3b0acd256**. The public trees exactly match the locally tested trees. Only publication source-history pins and their receipt binding changed during publication; the scientific inputs, implementations, proof, costs, and original predecessor bytes stayed fixed.

- Two separately constructed literal executions each check 524 core events and 184,832 completed literal/ideal pairs. Full prepared/returned Y, coefficient, dirty-D, cut, and Q arrays are compared before hashing. The primary reuses authenticated predecessors; the independent implementation imports no predecessor executable and separately constructs the actual Y paths.
- Both direct schedules agree with those full returned coefficient and Q arrays. Signed arithmetic, width, alias/ownership, zero-exit, malformed-input, source-integrity, and typed-receipt controls are explicit and remain active under optimized Python.
- Three preparation/readout/direct fixtures distinguish a source-bound Y91/Y90 nonterminal kernel direction, a terminal difference, and a five-active strong representative. These are not three additional full 524-event replays.
- Registered normal and optimized Python 3.12 replays pass. The actual public commit passes committed-byte and source-history checks for all 31 exported source files. The exact committed export passes its transport-integrity gate. Actual Git-free replay and hosted CI results are reported in the publication comment rather than prospectively marked passed here.

Receipt SHA256: `27cf939d8766ac4baa120117d738045c80f8bde285f91446945f52b0f81188a1`.

## Boundaries and next obligations

This is a closed **logical coefficient caller**. It does not supply a physical caller with those coefficient meanings, arbitrary raw-Y admission, the original full 2,025-event prefix, the whole 5,398-event word, or the 675 external-port contract. Physical routing/control, zero supply, access and ownership pricing, strict native/codec lowering, and the complete recursive bill remain open. The inherited 599/584 unchanged-profile stop and selected kappa remain unchanged. No human mathematical approval, formal kernel proof, or complete multiplication theorem is claimed.

TASK.json and README.md give two conditional next questions: name a real physical caller for this exact returned-state interface; or name an additional required, legally framed and fully priced readout that detects the source-bound kernel witness. Stop if no such consumer is justified. This package does not reserve a broader census or supplier construction.

The final canonical fetch at 05:29 UTC on 2026-10-18 remained main `20ecf2891d80b5acf18d980b2164fb44ea7faa90`, priority revision 6. Relevant guidance, selected record, frozen inputs and replay tools were unchanged from the scientific base `6f100d4bb5083f8c35d96fd95a539811c62f245c`. TASK.json records the handoff-first scope decision, complete open-PR checkpoint, subsequent bounded deltas, fresh canonical Discussion/hub checks and their coverage limits. No same-scope overlap was observed; this is not an exhaustive novelty claim.
